'''8D8''', also spelled '''Atedeate''', was an [[8D smelter droid]] manufactured by the [[Verpine/Legends|Verpine]] [[Roche Hive Mechanical Apparatus Design and Construction Activity for Those Who Need the Hive's Machines/Legends|Roche Hive]].

==Biography==
[[File:8D8-btm.jpg|thumb|left|200px|8D8 in [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|Jabba's Palace]].]]
8D8 was an [[8D smelter droid|8D Smelter droid]] manufactured by [[Roche Hive Mechanical Apparatus Design and Construction Activity for Those Who Need the Hive's Machines/Legends|Roche Hive Mechanical Apparatus Design and Construction Activity for Those Who Need the Hive's Machines]].<ref name="CharEnc" /> Originally a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] maintenance<ref name="SWCCG">{{CCG|set=Jabba's Palace Limited|cardname=8D8}}</ref> and heavy-labor industrial droid,<ref name="VD">''[[Star Wars: The Complete Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> 8D8 was sold to<ref name="SWCCG" /> and [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]]<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|I|223|8D8 (Atedeate)}}</ref> by the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]]<ref name="Jabba">{{FactFile|38|JAB 1-4|Jabba the Hutt}}</ref> [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]].<ref name="SWCCG" /> While in Jabba's employ, the smelter droid was lobotomized, reprogrammed, and used to torture both [[Droid/Legends|droids]] and [[Species/Legends|organics]].<ref name="DB" /> 

8D8 worked at [[Cyborg Operations]] within [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|Jabba's Palace]]<ref name="CSWE" /> on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]<ref name="CL" /> and was under the command<ref name="CSWE" /> of the overseer droid [[EV-9D9/Legends|EV-9D9]].<ref name="DB" /> The duties he performed within Cyborg Operations were menial and degrading.<ref name="GalaxiesWeb">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=68375&month=072009|text=Friday Feature &ndash; Game Update 12 -- Engineering Trader}}</ref> While working at the palace, 8D8 developed a<ref name="FF53">{{FactFile2014|53|SME 1-2|8D8 series}}</ref> secret<ref name="DB" /> hatred for EV-9D9, despite being devoted to<ref name="CL">''[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2005)|Star Wars: Complete Locations]]''</ref> her,<ref name="CharEnc" /> and for the [[J9 worker drone/Legends|J9 worker drone]] who worked in the palace,<ref name="FF53" /> [[BG-J38/Legends|BG-J38]].<ref name="BG-J38">{{CCG|set=Jabba's Palace Limited|cardname=BG-J38}}</ref>

Around [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], during the time that [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebels]] came to rescue [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] from Jabba, 8D8 was following EV-9D9's order by torturing a [[Unidentified power droid (Jabba's Palace)/Legends|GNK power droid]] with a mechanical smelting device featuring a hot, glowing iron.

==Characteristics==
The manic<ref name="Weekly18">''[[Return of the Jedi Weekly 18]]''</ref> 8D8 was sympathetic to the droids and aliens he was forced to torture.<ref name="SWCCG" /> He did not talk about his work in the torture dungeons in Jabba's palace.<ref name="Weekly18" /> Though he was devoted to EV-9D9,<ref name="CL" /> he hated her<ref name="FF53" /> and wanted to escape the unpleasant duties he did within Cyborg Operations.<ref name="Insider">{{InsiderCite|60|Who's Who in Jabba's Palace}}</ref>
